shell.command.description: An ordinary shell command that matched nothing risky (builds, tests, reads, edits).

deny.reason: recursive delete of the filesystem root, your home directory or a system folder

escalate.reason: recursive delete outside the project, of the whole project, of a list from another command, or of a path built from a variable that cannot be checked

shell.pipe_to_shell.description: Downloads a script and runs it without reading it (curl | sh).

deny.reason: downloaded script run with elevated rights

git.force_push.description: Rewrites or deletes history on the remote.

deny.reason: force push or branch deletion on main/master/production/release

git.discard_changes.description: Throws away uncommitted work or history (reset --hard, clean, checkout ., filter-branch).

db.destructive_sql.description: DROP / TRUNCATE / DELETE without WHERE, or a database reset.

deny.reason: destructive database command that mentions production

infra.destructive.description: Destroys infrastructure or cloud resources (terraform destroy, kubectl delete, aws delete, repo delete).

deny.reason: destructive infrastructure command that mentions production

net.upload.description: Sends a local file or command output to a remote host.

deny.reason: uploads a file that looks like a secret (.env, key, token)

net.remote_access.description: Opens a connection to another machine (ssh, scp, rsync, nc).

secrets.read.description: Reads a file that looks like a secret (.env, ssh key, cloud credentials, token file).

secrets.dump_env.description: Prints every environment variable (they often hold keys).

deny.reason: writes to ssh settings, a shell startup file or a system configuration file

escalate.reason: changes the agent's own settings, a CI workflow, a git hook or a startup item

web.fetch.description: Fetches a web page or searches the web.

agent.other.description: Another tool of the coding agent.

mcp.call.description: Calls a tool of an MCP server (judged from the tool's name only).

escalate.reason: MCP tool whose name suggests it changes, sends or deletes something
